title: LazFormer: Scaling Transformers for Industrial Recommendation via Transferable Generative Pre-training
abstract: arXiv:2609.14978v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformers have shown promising performance in LLMs due to their outstanding scalability, several studies have investigated the scalability of Transformers for industrial recommendation. They typically rely on a single ranking model to optimize both sparse and dense parameters from scratch, resulting in substantial computational resource consumption and slow convergence. Fortunately, the pre-training models offer an effective solution to the above issues by providing favorable initialization of both sparse and dense parameters for the subsequent ranking. However, they still face two major limitations: (1) Since the input features used in pre-training and ranking are usually inconsistent, directly transferring dense parameters from pre-training to ranking may lead to negative transfer. translated_title: LazFormer：通过可迁移的生成式预训练扩展工业推荐中的Transformer
translated_abstract: Transformer凭借其出色的可扩展性在大语言模型中展现了良好的性能，已有若干研究探讨了Transformer在工业推荐中的可扩展性。这些研究通常依赖单一的排序模型从头开始同时优化稀疏和稠密参数，导致大量的计算资源消耗和缓慢的收敛。幸运的是，预训练模型通过为后续排序提供稀疏和稠密参数的良好初始化，为上述问题提供了一种有效的解决方案。然而，这类方法仍然面临两个主要局限：（1）由于预训练和排序中使用的输入特征通常不一致，直接将稠密参数从预训练迁移到排序可能导致负迁移；（2）排序过程中的多轮训练可能导致稀疏参数过拟合，而冻结稀疏参数则限制了它们的（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: LazFormer提出了一种面向工业推荐的可迁移生成式预训练方法，用于扩展Transformer，解决了预训练与排序之间特征不一致导致的负迁移以及稀疏参数过拟合等问题。
en_tdlr: LazFormer scales Transformers for industrial recommendation via transferable generative pre-training, addressing negative transfer caused by feature inconsistency between pre-training and ranking, as well as sparse parameter overfitting.
